sourceAttempts.result: Names Bolton Dam, Bolton Canoe Access Area, Jonesville and Floodplain Preserve as public Winooski launch or takeout points.
Documents the approximately 10.5-mile day paddle, public access sequence, the rapid below Bolton Dam, portage option and Floodplain Preserve short carry.
Corroborates the Bolton–Richmond corridor, dam boundary and access needs; informal or private alternatives were excluded.
USGS 04290500 near Essex Junction supplies direct Winooski River discharge telemetry for the lower corridor.

thresholdEvidence.reachApplicability: Conservative planning band for the documented Bolton–Richmond day-paddle corridor; verify live Essex Junction telemetry, trend, weather, wood and dam conditions.

endpointAudit.reviewNote: Bolton, Jonesville and Floodplain are public access-area edges; the audit's review classification is expected. Floodplain is a sandy-bar landing with a short carry to parking, and Bolton Dam has a marked portage approach.

safetyAndCamping: All six routes carry PFD, cold-water, strainer, fast-rise, dam, private-bank and current-access controls. The Bolton rapid is explicitly scouted and portaged when needed. No route includes overnight camping; established campgrounds outside the day-use access points are the only camping option.
validation: Canonical geometries generated for all six routes; endpoint audits returned no suspicious or failed findings.
Route safety and gallery audits passed.
Production build passed after registration and geometry refresh.
pending: Confirm current municipal/GMP access, parking, dam notices, flow trend, weather and wood before launch; no deployment has been performed.
